payload.title: Lint rejects a Blocked field that says DELIVERED
payload.body:
Stale task blocks keep a Blocked reason that says the work was DELIVERED. The linter now flags them. Source idea: https://github.com/fyodoriv/minsky/blob/main/scripts/check-no-delivered-retained-blocks.mjs
- **Hypothesis**: A lint error on DELIVERED in Blocked drops stale delivered blocks in linted TASKS.md files from >0 to 0, because authors see the error at commit time.
- **Measurement**: `npx vitest run packages/lint` passes with a fixture that holds a DELIVERED Blocked field.
- **Success**: The fixture produces exactly one error and clean fixtures produce none.
- **Pivot**: If the rule flags a legitimate Blocked reason in the repo's own TASKS.md, narrow the match or drop the rule.
- **Anchor**: Kitchenham, Dybå, Jørgensen 2004 (evidence-based SE): checks must catch the defect class they target.
